snippet.title: Azhar Erriad: Destruction  -  Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
One year later, Azhar Erriad School has been totally abandoned and taken over by permanganate. The place is falling apart, and no one dares to go near it. But Rayane has no choice, he sneaks back into the creepy, ruined school to get his backpack that he left behind. 

He thinks it’ll be quick and easy, but as he goes deeper inside, he starts to regret coming back. The school feels more dangerous than ever, and Rayane realizes he might not be alone.
